# RAR test fixtures

Minimal archives used by `internal/formats/rar` tests. All are third-party
redistributable samples (not generated by zipstar — RAR create is unsupported).

| File | Source | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `testfile.rar3.rar`, `testfile.rar5.rar` | [ssokolow/rar-test-files](https://github.com/ssokolow/rar-test-files) `build/` | Plain RAR4/RAR5; member `testfile.txt` = `Testing 123\n` |
| `testfile.rar3.solid.rar`, `testfile.rar5.solid.rar` | same | Solid-flagged single-member archives |
| `solid.rar` | [sharpcompress](https://github.com/adamhathcock/sharpcompress) `Rar.solid.rar` | Multi-member solid RAR |
| `encrypted_files_only.rar`, `rar5_encrypted_files_only.rar` | sharpcompress | Per-file encryption; password `test` |
| `encrypted_files_and_header.rar`, `rar5_encrypted_files_and_header.rar` | sharpcompress | Header encryption; password `test` |
| `encrypted_junrar.rar` | [junrar](https://github.com/junrar/junrar) `rar4-encrypted-junrar.rar` | Header-encrypted; password `junrar`; member `file1.txt` |
| `parent_dir.rar` | junrar | Zip-slip style path `../../tmp/existing-file` |
| `multivol/multi.part0{1-6}.rar` | sharpcompress `Rar.multi.part*.rar` | Multi-volume; open `multi.part01.rar` |

ssokolow fixtures are intended for free redistribution. SharpCompress / junrar
archives are used as typical open-source test corpus samples.
